card.name: Small words before journal names
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as 'the', 'of' and 'in' right before a medical journal name, mostly in news reports of a study ('published in', 'issue of the'). Also a period before a journal abbreviation in a citation.

modes.label: Issue of the journal
modes.description: 'of' or 'the' after 'issue' just before the journal title.
modes.example: The study and editorial appear in the June 21 issue of<< the>> Annals of Internal Medicine.

modes.label: Published in journal
modes.description: 'in' right after 'published' or 'studies', leading into a journal name.
modes.example: according to the report published<< in>> Pediatrics.

modes.label: Citation end
modes.description: Period ending a reference title before the journal abbreviation.
modes.example: Oral contraceptives and nonfatal vascular disease<<.>> Obstet Gynecol 19

card.plain: It lights up on the little word just before the name of a medical journal where a study was published.
